rationale: Class 2/aggregate rate-fill review. The bundle shows a dl_rate_fill weak flag with metric 75.0 and four missing-rate units among sixteen, including corporate bond rows whose extracted interest_rate is blank. Raw source table 247 prints coupons in the instrument text for Vista Outdoor (4.50%), iHeartCommunications 2026 (6.38%), and iHeartCommunications 2027 (8.38%). Those source rates should have populated interest_rate, so the flag reflects a real extraction gap. The Grayson asset-backed row has no visible source rate, so it is not used as a culprit.
